design.neutrality_rule: Cards specify tasks and structure only; they do not request a verdict or intentional defect.

shared_environment.complete_path_universe: four mode x ready finite-input traces under the no-parallel Q4 restriction

cards.assignment: Coordinate a handover of payload_alpha from the left arm to the right arm, including approach, grasp preparation, the authority transfer, departure, and orderly completion actions.
structure_requirements: Use a straight-line task body with no if, for, or parallel.
Target 12-24 source API calls without padding.

cards.assignment: Transfer payload_alpha from left to right, choosing a direct or staged handover procedure according to mode; both branches must complete the same requested handover task.

Give both branches multiple meaningful actions.
Do not use for or parallel.
Target 12-24 source API calls across the source.
